role: Independent mechanical path/accounting/identity audit; not policy development, forecast validation, a causal analysis, human review, or a risk certificate.
outcome_exposure: The influential original scenario IDs35/52/98/112 and their old breach/event labels were already known from frozen prior diagnostics. This plan is declared before reading any newly produced path-mechanism output. It is post-hoc diagnosis, not blind model evaluation.

identity_scope.fixed_inventory: Exactly11model-versus-own-B pairs: fourIDs35/52/98/112 under full old selected fixed policy and own selected-beta original-inner program (8pairs), plus r2_ID52/r4_ID112/r5_ID112 (3pairs); exact pair/job/fan/target identities require root-frozen protocol.
identity_scope.market: Only complete original development IDs1..120 through guarded load_paths(...allow_final=False), preserving original annual joint asset/inflation chronology. Do not parse return/inflation values121..180.
identity_scope.same_fit_comparison: Each M/B pair must have exactly same original scenario ID, job, H=30, L=.4, target and own training IDs. Different fits of the same original ID are descriptive cross-fit comparisons; targets/fans may differ and must be disclosed.

independence.permitted_project_import: Only guarded safeinvest.data.load_paths for the complete development arrays.
independence.prohibited_imports: No new path-mechanism producer/runner, reviewed policy/rollout/metric/execution modules, or new fitting/selection routines.
independence.actual_action_scope: Replay all22accounts independently from saved model actions and independently derived own-B annual-before-breach/hold-after-breach actions. This verifies recorded mechanical paths, not independent recomputation of every adaptive Q/action choice.

checks: Require frozen root protocol, complete producer manifest, exact source/input SHA start/end equality, output SHA matches, and untouched protocol before any new output values are read.

Require exact11pair inventory and unique330pair-years/660account-years/682account-endpoints. Check own target, fan IDs/inclusion, original period, scenario, source group, accounting status and Review/hypothetical labels.

Independently solve exact self-financing fee C=.0025*sum positive((V-C)*w-x) with100bisectionsteps, restoring destination amount once; same initial charge, no hold/terminal fee. Rebuild posttrade holdings and every later holding/weight/wealth endpoint.

Rebuild CPI from actual inflation, original peak100 and all elapsed annual endpoints, current drawdown, running original-history MDD, threshold strict excess>1e-12, first crossing, and absorbing pending at next decision. Recovery cannot reset/restart the service.

Compare all saved predecision/posttrade/endyear quantities, actions, fees and moved amounts to independent scalar reference. For B, derive actions independently from its own history, never borrow M breach state.

All initial and pending Q/risk/score values must be unavailable/NULL; all B Q values unavailable/NULL. At active model states compare copied saved Qs/counts/actions to frozen parent source and independently recalculate finite technical-price score using total remaining logs and originalH; do not subtract fees twice or call this forecast calibration.
Independently check per-year logwealth-gap increment = difference in log fee survival + difference in posttrade gross logreturn; common actual CPI cancels only within same original calendar path.

Independently check nominalgap = inherited nominalgap*B posttrade gross + (Bfee-Mfee)*B posttrade gross + (Mprewealth-Mfee)*(Mposttrade gross-Bposttrade gross); realgap divides this by common endpointCPI. Also check direct3asset gap recursion.

Independently verify currentDD_M-currentDD_B = realwealth_B/peak_B-realwealth_M/peak_M, separately preserving each arm peak. RunningMDD gap is a difference between pathwise running maxima, not a sum of currentDD gaps.

Identify first action divergence and first posttrade exposure/holdings/wealth/peak/currentDD/runningMDD divergence separately; identical initial restore action does not imply identical target exposure. Verify firstcrossing and its preceding original year for both arms, with no-breach values NULL.

Preserve all NULLs and missing-source statuses. Missing inner B source trace is reconstructed openly by independent B accounting and compared to frozen same-job B endpoint metrics; do not invent a parent trace.
Cross-fit summaries retain each fit own weights/fan/eta/selection status. Repeated ID112 is one original market trajectory appearing under distinct fits, not independent market risk observations.

numeric_contract.first_divergence_tolerance: Use the producer protocol explicit comparison tolerance unchanged, with separately declared financial-unit/weight-unit meaning; no outcome-driven adjustment.

failure_rule: No successful audit receipt on an incomplete or failed check; no changing old sources, dropping IDs, changing controller/target/alpha/eta/admission, replacing missing paths, or choosing another test witness after results.
interpretation_limits: Accounting decompositions are exact mechanical identities along already-selected realized paths; ordering of reference/gross terms is a convention and is not a unique causal contribution.
The first realized difference or crossing localizes a path; it does not isolate the cause due to target choice, fan membership, eta, conditional-law error or B continuation approximation.
Replay from saved actions establishes accounting correctness, not optimality or complete independent validation of every adaptive forecast.

No new automatic admission evidence is created. Current full C remains execution_review with financial outputsNULL until an independently justified later decision; no paper or final heldout evaluation is authorized by this audit.
